sentimento.text1: The presidential book holds USD 148.03M and the prices on this page come from the confirmed reading of 11/Sep, 1:41 PM BRT (4:41 PM UTC). 📈 THE GAP IN THE WINNER CONTRACT WIDENED FOR THE SECOND DAY: Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 53.95% (vol USD 10.36M accumulated) and Lula at 42.50% (vol USD 10.69M), against 52.85% and 43.50% in the confirmed reading of 10/Sep. That is 1.10pp up for one and 1.00pp down for the other, and the distance between them went from 9.35pp to 11.45pp. ⚠️ THE SIZE OF THE MOVE IS ONE TENTH OF YESTERDAY'S, when the book travelled 6.60pp and 9.00pp and changed hands at the top. Today it keeps the same direction, slowly. ⭐ The 53.95% sits 1.15pp below the peak of his series, of 55.10% on 10/Sep, even though it is above the 52.85% of yesterday's confirmed reading. Lula, at 42.50%, sits 25.00pp below his own peak of 67.50% on 16/Aug.
sentimento.text2: 📊 IN THE SECOND-PLACE CONTRACT FOR THE [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) the move is the reverse of yesterday's: Flávio Bolsonaro rose 3.00pp, to 74.50% (vol USD 725 thousand), and Lula fell 1.60pp, to 22.90% (vol USD 601 thousand). Yesterday this contract had moved the other way, with 7.00pp down and 4.90pp up. 🥉 IN THE THIRD-PLACE CONTRACT the distance more than doubled in 24 hours: Augusto Cury rose 3.65pp, to 52.90% (vol USD 160 thousand), and Renan Santos fell 4.00pp, to 38.50% (vol USD 297 thousand). The gap went from 6.75pp to 14.40pp, and Renan Santos's fall is the largest of any contract on the panel this round. 🗳️ The Senate majority contract gets a new price, with Partido Liberal at 83.00% (vol USD 261 thousand) and MDB at 9.05%.
sentimento.text3: ⭐ TODAY'S POLL ALLOWS THE CLEANEST COMPARISON OF THE WEEK, because it comes from the SAME HOUSE that measured eleven days earlier, with the same method and the same margin. In AtlasIntel together with Bloomberg, fieldwork from 04 to 09/Sep, 5,000 interviews and a 1.0pp margin, Lula's lead in the first round fell from 9.7 points to 5.6: he went from 43.4% to 43.0% and Flávio Bolsonaro went from 33.7% to 37.4%. 🔁 AND ALL FIVE RUNOFF PAIRINGS MOVED IN THE SAME DIRECTION, two of them flipping sign: against Flávio, from 47.1% to 42.6% into 46.4% to 46.2%; against Romeu Zema, from 47.0% to 40.7% into 46.2% to 46.0%; against Ronaldo Caiado, from 46.6% to 41.0% into an exact tie at 45.7%; against Renan Santos, from 47.5% to 26.0% into 46.0% to 33.8%. ⚠️ In the first three the difference fits inside two margins of 1.0, so what the house measures is a STATISTICAL TIE and not a lead. The two pairings that fall outside the margin are Augusto Cury's, by 2.7 points, and Renan Santos's, by 12.2. 📌 With it, that makes EIGHT consecutive national polls since 06/Sep in which Lula does not come out ahead in the pairing against Flávio Bolsonaro. And where the two instruments diverge is in SIZE, not direction: the book marks 11.45pp of distance, the house with the smallest margin in the window measures two tenths.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 53.95% in the winner contract, 1.15pp below the peak of his series, of 55.10% on 10/Sep, and at 74.50% in the second-place contract for the first round. In the AtlasIntel of 10/Sep he has 37.4% in the first round, up 3.7 points against the same house's reading on 31/Aug, and 46.4% against Lula's 46.2% in the runoff pairing, a difference that fits inside the margin. Ronaldo Caiado stands at 0.30% in the winner contract and TIES EXACTLY with Lula at 45.7% in a runoff pairing from the same house.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 42.50% in the winner contract, a second straight day of decline, and at 22.90% in the second-place contract for the first round, giving back part of yesterday's gain. In the AtlasIntel of 10/Sep he has 43.0% in the first round, practically the same 43.4% of eleven days earlier, with his lead shrinking because his rival rose. Across the five runoff pairings he loses none outside the margin, and he wins the only two that fall outside it. Fernando Haddad remains at 0.05% in the winner contract, with USD 7.53M accumulated.
sentimento.terceiraVia: Augusto Cury is the favourite in the third-place contract for the first round, at 52.90% and up 3.65pp, and he has 6.6% in the first round of the AtlasIntel. Renan Santos fell 4.00pp in that same contract, to 38.50%, and has 6.5% in the poll, but his contract still holds USD 13.26M accumulated, the second largest individual volume in the book. Romeu Zema records 2.1% in the first round, his highest value in the window, and comes out ahead of Lula by 46.2% to 46.0% in a runoff pairing, inside the margin.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of 11/Sep, 1:41 PM BRT (4:41 PM UTC). ⭐ In this round all FIVE watched contracts received a new price: winner, second place in the first round, third place in the first round, impeachment at the Supreme Court and Senate majority. AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, taken eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp.

inss.text1: 📌 THERE IS NO NEW INSS ACT ON 11/Sep. The topic remains tied to the same institutional thread as previous rounds, and the day's news coverage concentrates on the Supreme Court crisis and on the developments of the Master case.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: The Federal Police operation of 10/Sep on the financing of the film Dark Horse does not concern the INSS, and the page does not merge the two cases. What links them is the institution in the middle, not the object of the investigation.
inss.impactoLula: The structured reading of government approval remains the Genial/Quaest of 07/Sep, with fieldwork from 03 to 06/Sep: 43% approve and 50% disapprove. There was no new approval round on 10/Sep, and the panel keeps one pollster per block on purpose, so that the internal series does not mix.
inss.impactoGestao: Within Quaest itself the picture stopped being one of stillness. On 05/Aug it was 48% approval against 47% disapproval, on 14/Aug 46% against 48%, and on 07/Sep 43% against 50%. That is 5 points of decline in approval and 3 points of rise in disapproval in about a month, measured by the same pollster with the same design.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the subject is narrow: there was no new INSS act on 10/Sep, and government approval still rests on the reading of 07/Sep. The movement of the day is in the market and at the Supreme Court, not here.

bancoMaster.text1: 🔴 THE ACT OF 11/Sep IS THE LIFTING OF SECRECY, AND WHAT IT REVEALED. On the night of 10/Sep, at 11:44 PM, André Mendonça granted a request by Edson Fachin and lifted the secrecy on 14 proceedings in the Master case, among them the main inquiry into the attempted sale of the bank to BRB and the petition on the messages exchanged between the former banker and Alexandre de Moraes (Gazeta do Povo and Poder360, both on 11/Sep). ⚠️ AND IT WAS THE LIFTING OF SECRECY THAT MADE THE FOLLOWING PUBLIC: senator Flávio Bolsonaro has been under Federal Police investigation SINCE JULY 2026, authorised by Mendonça himself, for money laundering, currency evasion and corruption in the financing of the film Dark Horse. The investigation did not begin today; what changed on 11/Sep is that it stopped being secret (Gazeta do Povo, Poder360 and CartaCapital, outlets independent of one another).
bancoMaster.text2: 🏛️ ON THE SAME DAY, Alexandre de Moraes stated that Mendonça did not lift the secrecy in full and that 180 documents were left out, accused him of a selective choice and asked for the cases to be judged together (Poder360, Metrópoles and Gazeta do Povo, on 11/Sep). 📅 The chronology the record supports is this: in mid-May 2026 audio recordings became public about the charge of R$ 134 million for the production, of which R$ 61 million would have been paid; in July the Federal Police opened the inquiry with Mendonça's authorisation; on 10/Sep Flávio Dino authorised the operation that had former secretary Mario Frias as its central target; on the night of 10/Sep secrecy was lifted; and on 11/Sep the content became public.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ The price on this page comes from the 1:41 PM BRT reading, LATER than the morning disclosure. In that reading, the winner contract of the person under investigation rose 1.10pp, without renewing the peak of his own series, which remains at 55.10% from 10/Sep. AFOS records the order of events and does not attribute cause to the price, because the book is arbitraged continuously and no single reading separates one motive from another.
bancoMaster.conclusao: What changes on 11/Sep is not the existence of the investigation, but public access to it. A record under judicial seal and a public record are different states of the SAME fact, and confusing the two produces a headline that says "has become the target of an investigation" where the correct wording is "has been under investigation since July, and today that became public". The distinction is not a formality: it moves the date of the event by almost two months.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act on 10/Sep. He remains a target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos, alongside Alexandre de Moraes.
stf.moraes: No new individual act on 10/Sep. ⚠️ The extraordinary session that examines the request to investigate him is scheduled for 15/Sep, and it is to that session that Folha de S.Paulo and Estadão tie this week's cancellations. According to Folha, he prepared a public statement and postponed it.
stf.gilmar: No new individual act on 10/Sep. His request for more time, on 08/Sep, in the virtual session examining the removal of the Federal Police leadership, became moot with the reinstatement ordered on 09/Sep.
stf.dino: 🔴 NEW ACT ON 10/Sep: he authorised the Federal Police operation on the financing of the film Dark Horse and ordered precautionary measures against Mario Frias, among them a ban on leaving the country and on contacting other people under investigation. The decision points to evidence of diversion of public funds through parliamentary earmarks. On 09/Sep he had already reversed the removal of the Federal Police leadership.
stf.mendonca: No new individual act on 10/Sep. On 08/Sep he removed the Federal Police leadership for 90 days, a decision reversed by Flávio Dino on 09/Sep, and on 09/Sep he approved the plea agreement of the businessman who operated transfers to the film's fund.
stf.nexo: The link to the election is one of calendar and institution, not of outcome. In three days one justice removed the Federal Police leadership, another reversed the removal, a third approved a plea agreement about the financing of a film tied to the surroundings of one of the campaigns, and the president of the Court cancelled two consecutive plenary sessions. The session that decides on the request to investigate a justice is scheduled for 15/Sep, less than a month before the first round.
stf.analise: 🏛️ THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 ALMOST DOUBLED: it stands at 8.30% (vol USD 90 thousand), confirmed reading of 11/Sep, 1:41 PM BRT, against 4.35% in the confirmed reading of 10/Sep, up 3.95pp. 📈 It remains 17.80pp below the peak of the series, of 26.10% recorded on 11/Sep itself at 5:00 AM BRT, and 6.20pp above the floor, of 2.10% on 08/Jun. In other words, the book rose much earlier in the day and had already given back most of it by the time this reading was taken. ⚠️ The accumulated volume, USD 90 thousand, is small enough that isolated orders can move the price, and that caveat holds in both directions: it held when it fell and it holds now that it has risen. 📌 The move happens the day after secrecy was lifted on 14 proceedings in the Master case and on the same day Alexandre de Moraes accused the lifting of being selective and asked for the cases to be judged together. AFOS records the coincidence of dates and does not attribute cause.
stf.fachin: 🔴 NEW ACT ON 10/Sep: he cancelled the plenary session for the SECOND day running (Folha de S.Paulo, O Globo, Estadão, Valor Econômico and Gazeta do Povo). The first cancellation was on 09/Sep. The extraordinary session that examines the request to investigate Alexandre de Moraes remains scheduled for 15/Sep.
